item.title: Ancient Topazios was a source of peridot, not modern topaz
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Historical accounts link the Red Sea island Topazios, now Zabargad, to the green gem peridot. Trade names changed as gem identification improved.
EXIMUTC view: Historical names are not mineral IDs. Distinguish peridot from topaz using gemological properties.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/peridot-history-lore
